pages.title: Main tabs
pages.text: The energy tab shows FE and capacity; hovering progress shows recipe, time and products. Redstone control offers ignore, low-power and signal modes. Security manages access, side configuration sets item/fluid/energy directions, and ejector controls automatic output.

pages.title: Centrifuge buttons
pages.text: The PB Recipe button opens JEI centrifuge recipes; the input-return button restores the previous input search. The multi-fluid tab opens a paged window showing fluid type, capacity and allocated slots. Arrows below the output matrix page through parallel slots.

pages.title: Window positions
pages.text: The client remembers tab and window positions. If a window disappears after changing resolution or GUI scale, open Client Settings → Custom Window Positions and reset that window instead of deleting the entire configuration. Hover every slot for a detailed status tooltip.
